rows.text: stores `01CB2498` to qword `[rcx]`; when dword `[rcx+8]` is non-zero it makes the call at `00793410` + 0x3C with qword `[rcx+0x10]` if that qword is non-null and bit 31 of the dword is clear, then stores 0 to qword `[rcx+0x10]` and dword `[rcx+8]`; it then repeats the test on the current dword `[rcx+8]` and qword `[rcx+0x10]` (bit 31 clear and qword non-null) for the call at `00793410` + 0x5E, and on every path ends by storing 0 to qword `[rcx+0x10]` and dword `[rcx+8]`

notes: 00793410: the second test can only lead to the + 0x5E call when dword [rcx+8] was 0 on entry, since the first block zeroes both fields otherwise.
